modelOverview: The Royal Oak Offshore Diver is Audemars Piguet's purpose-built dive watch: a 42mm octagonal Offshore case with an internal rotating dive bezel operated by a second crown at 10 o'clock, screw-locked crowns and 300m of water resistance. The current 15720ST generation, introduced in 2021, replaced the long-running 15710ST with the in-house Calibre 4308, a sapphire caseback, black ceramic crowns and a tool-free interchangeable rubber strap system, offered in a range of Méga Tapisserie dial colours. Every example we offer is sourced and authenticated before sale.

15720ST.OO.A027CA.01.description: The 15720ST.OO.A027CA.01 is the blue-dial version of the 2021 Royal Oak Offshore Diver, pairing a 42mm stainless steel case and black ceramic crowns with a blue Méga Tapisserie dial and a black inner rotating bezel marked in white. It runs the in-house Calibre 4308 with a 60-hour reserve, visible through the sapphire caseback, and is delivered on a blue rubber strap with a second black strap for the quick-change system. Every example we offer is sourced and authenticated before sale.
